integrity: The modular identity is cited as an infinite analytic identity; finite exact arithmetic and truncated series are independent checks only. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical rational X_H(4800) modular model is treated. The theorem counts closed cusps, not all rational points, and gives one nontrivial rational Jacobian 2-torsion point, not the complete torsion subgroup.
title: Arithmetic cusps and explicit rational \(2\)-torsion on the genus-\(1777\) modular curve
